label: JSON Extract
description: Extracts a nested value from a previous step's output data using a dot-notation path.

path.description: Dot-notation path into the step output data (e.g. `body.user.name`).

fromStep.description: Step name to read from. Defaults to the most recently completed step.

defaultValue.description: Value returned when the path is not found. Omit to return null.

value.description: The extracted value, or the defaultValue when the path is not found.
